title: SimpleText and UniformSplit Codec Coordination
description: This cluster groups SimpleText codec classes with UniformSplit posting components. The SimpleText classes provide readable codec formats, while UniformSplit classes encode, decode, and read block-based posting data. These components interact through postings format, block reader, encoder, decoder, and dictionary structures. The architecture supports maintainability through separated reader/writer responsibilities and modular codec implementations. Technologies used include Java and Apache Lucene codec APIs.

title: UniformSplit Shared Terms Reading Support
description: This cluster supports shared-term reading in the UniformSplit codec. It includes utilities for RAM estimation, byte-level term representation, merging term enumerations, and reading shared terms. The components interact to manage term metadata efficiently during index access. The architecture improves maintainability and memory awareness by separating utility, data representation, and reader responsibilities. Technologies used include Java and Apache Lucene indexing abstractions.

title: SimpleText Vector and UniformSplit Metadata Handling
description: This cluster combines SimpleText KNN vector format classes with UniformSplit field metadata. The vector classes handle readable KNN vector storage and writing, while metadata classes describe fields used during postings processing. These components interact around codec-level data representation. The architecture supports modularity by separating vector format handling from field metadata management. Technologies used include Java, Apache Lucene codecs, and KNN vector indexing APIs.

title: UniformSplit Terms Reading and Writing Architecture
description: This cluster contains UniformSplit and shared-terms classes responsible for block writing, block reading, term storage, and term enumeration. Writers create block-based term structures, while readers and merging readers retrieve and combine terms. These components interact to support efficient term dictionary access. The architecture improves scalability and maintainability through block-oriented processing and clear reader/writer separation. Technologies used include Java and Apache Lucene term/postings APIs.

title: Lucene Codec Formats and Postings Implementations
description: This large cluster groups multiple Lucene codec implementations including block terms, block tree ordinals, bloom filtering, memory postings, and SimpleText formats. The components provide different strategies for storing, reading, filtering, and writing index structures such as terms, postings, doc values, points, stored fields, and term vectors. The architecture supports extensibility and maintainability through interchangeable codec formats. Technologies used include Java and Apache Lucene codec framework APIs.

title: UniformSplit Block Line Serialization
description: This cluster focuses on block line representation and term state serialization for UniformSplit codecs. BlockLine classes represent encoded block entries, while the serializer manages delta-based term state persistence. These components interact during block encoding and decoding. The architecture supports efficiency and maintainability by isolating low-level serialization from higher-level codec logic. Technologies used include Java and Apache Lucene UniformSplit codec internals.

title: Codec Package Metadata and FST Dictionary Support
description: This cluster mainly contains package-level metadata for codec modules and an FST dictionary implementation. The package-info files document codec packages, while FSTDictionary supports dictionary-based term lookup for UniformSplit processing. These components provide organizational and lookup support for the codec subsystem. The architecture supports maintainability through clear package documentation and reusable dictionary functionality. Technologies used include Java, Apache Lucene codecs, and finite-state transducer concepts.

title: Shared-Term Field Metadata Writing
description: This cluster supports writing and combining field metadata for shared-term UniformSplit codecs. FieldMetadataTermState represents per-field term state, STUniformSplitTermsWriter writes shared-term structures, and UnionFieldMetadataBuilder combines metadata across fields. The components interact to build consistent shared-term metadata during indexing. The architecture supports scalability and maintainability through separated metadata construction and writing responsibilities. Technologies used include Java and Apache Lucene indexing APIs.

title: UniformSplit Block Header and Terms Writing
description: This cluster contains components for writing UniformSplit term data and block headers. BlockHeader stores block-level metadata, while UniformSplitTermsWriter writes terms using block-based structures. These components interact during index creation to organize term data efficiently. The architecture supports performance and maintainability through compact block metadata and dedicated writer logic. Technologies used include Java and Apache Lucene codec internals.

title: Bloom Filter Hashing Utility
description: This cluster contains MurmurHash64, a hashing utility used by Bloom filter based codec components. It provides hash computation needed for probabilistic membership checks. The component interacts with bloom filtering structures to support fast lookup decisions. The architecture supports performance and scalability by enabling efficient hash-based filtering. Technologies used include Java and Apache Lucene bloom codec utilities.
